meta.title: Numbers to 1000 Song | Grade 2 Maths for Kids | Little Takhti
meta.description: Sing along with Takhti and learn numbers to 1000! Ten ones make a ten, ten tens make a hundred, and every digit has its place: hundreds, tens and ones. Find out what the zero in 708 means, compare 452 and 425, count by hundreds to 1000, then shout the answers in the quiz.

els.html: 345 = three hundred and forty-five
708 = seven hundred and eight
